name: Generate a Salesforce REST data-product source

checks.check: The generated closure reflects the pinned Salesforce instance, SOQL query, records envelope, and continuation contract.
Ingestion uses dlt RESTAPIConfig/rest_api_resources with profile-driven endpoint and query configuration.
The records array is selected and nextRecordsUrl is handled as response-link pagination.
Bearer auth and scope are flat profile attributes, the token is private and absent from source, and the generated source contains no DML operations.
